items.title: Avakian George — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I never knew that much about Erroll until the book by James Doran came out

ctx.x: So that the rest of us don’t know much about him.

Yeah, that’s true. I never realized that until I saw a reference to that, and Martha mentioned it again years later. I didn’t realize that, that there were no interviews published about Erroll. As a matter of fact, I never knew that much about Erroll until the book by James Doran came out, which was apparently a pretty good biography. He did a lot of interviewing of people who had known him. At the same time, you didn’t really have to know facts beyond that he was just a kid who couldn’t read music, from…
